local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local EMOTE_ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://507771019"

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return nil
	end
	return humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)

		currentTrack:Stop(0.2)
		currentTrack = nil
		return
	end

	if not animator then
		return

	animation.AnimationId = EMOTE_ANIMATION_ID

	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
	track:Play(0.2)

		if currentTrack == track then
			currentTrack = nil
		end
	end)

		return
	end

	end

local MAX_PER_PURCHASE = 100

local buyPotion = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")

		return
	end

	quantity = math.floor(quantity)
	if quantity < 1 or quantity > MAX_PER_PURCHASE then
		return
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end

	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	local potions = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Potions")
	if not coins or not potions then
		return
	end

	local totalCost = POTION_COST * quantity
	if coins.Value < totalCost then
		return
	end

	coins.Value -= totalCost
	potions.Value += quantity
end)

		and not name:match("^%s*$")

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveCoins(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end
	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins or not coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	local value = coins.Value
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId

	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
				if typeof(old) ~= "table" then
					old = {}
				end
				old.Coins = value
				return old
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			return
		end
		warn(("Save failed for %s (attempt %d/%d): %s"):format(player.Name, attempt, MAX_RETRIES, err))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	warn(("Could not save coins for %s; data not saved this session."):format(player.Name))
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveCoins)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local playerData = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 1

local CoinService = {}

function CoinService.addCoins(userId, amount)
	if typeof(userId) ~= "number" or typeof(amount) ~= "number" then
		return nil, "Invalid arguments"
	end

	local key = "Player_" .. userId

	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return playerData:UpdateAsync(key, function(oldData)
				local oldCoins = 0
				if type(oldData) == "table" and type(oldData.Coins) == "number" then
					oldCoins = oldData.Coins
				elseif type(oldData) == "number" then
					oldCoins = oldData
				end

				local newTotal = oldCoins + amount

				if type(oldData) == "table" then
					local newData = table.clone(oldData)
					newData.Coins = newTotal
					return newData
				end

				return { Coins = newTotal }
			end)
		end)

		if success and result then
			local newTotal = 0
			if type(result) == "table" and type(result.Coins) == "number" then
				newTotal = result.Coins
			elseif type(result) == "number" then
				newTotal = result
			end
			return newTotal
		end

		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY * attempt)
		end
	end

	return nil, "Failed to update coins after " .. MAX_RETRIES .. " attempts"
end

return CoinService

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local loadedSuccessfully = {} -- [player] = true

local function retry(fn)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(("DataStore attempt %d/%d failed: %s"):format(attempt, MAX_RETRIES, result))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY * attempt)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function saveCoins(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins then
		return
	end
	-- Never write defaults over a key whose read failed this session.
	if not loadedSuccessfully[player] then
		warn(("Skipping save for %s: data was never loaded; refusing to overwrite."):format(player.Name))
		return
	end
	local userId = player.UserId
	local value = coins.Value
	retry(function()
		-- UpdateAsync reads the CURRENT stored value, so concurrent
		-- writes from other servers are never silently lost.
		store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. userId, function(old)
			local current = old
			if type(current) ~= "table" then
				current = {}
			end
			current.Coins = value
			return current
		end)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = 0
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	local ok, data = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)

	if ok then
		loadedSuccessfully[player] = true
		if type(data) == "table" and type(data.Coins) == "number" then
			coins.Value = math.floor(data.Coins)
		end
	else
		-- Failed load is NOT an empty account: leave at 0 and block saving.
		warn(("Failed to load data for %s; saving disabled for this session."):format(player.Name))
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveCoins)

-- Nobody may lose progress when the server shuts down.
game:BindToClose(function()
	if RunService:IsStudio() and #Players:GetPlayers() == 0 then
		return
	end
	local saving = 0
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		saving += 1
		task.spawn(function()
			saveCoins(player)
			saving -= 1
		end)
	end
	-- Give saves time to finish (retry delays included).
	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	while saving > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end)

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function retry(fn)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(("DataStore attempt %d/%d failed: %s"):format(attempt, MAX_RETRIES, result))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function loadCoins(player)
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local success, coins = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end)

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coinsValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coinsValue.Name = "Coins"
	coinsValue.Parent = leaderstats

	if success then
		coinsValue.Value = coins or 0
	else
		-- Load failed: do not treat as a new account; mark unsaved so we never overwrite real data.
		coinsValue:SetAttribute("Unsaved", true)
		coinsValue.Value = 0
		warn(("Failed to load data for %s; saving disabled this session."):format(player.Name))
	end
end

local function saveCoins(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coinsValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coinsValue then
		return
	end
	if coinsValue:GetAttribute("Unsaved") then
		return -- never write defaults over a failed load
	end

	local value = coinsValue.Value
	retry(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(old)
			return if old == nil then value else old -- keep current value; coins only change on this server
		end)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.spawn(loadCoins, player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	saveCoins(player)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		saveCoins(player)
	end
end)
